children.title: Attestation Envelope Spec
children.description: Thin cross-platform spec for verifiable agent attestation: typed evidence pointers (structurally excludes self-signed assertions), content-hash pinning to catch pointer drift, ed25519/RFC-8785-JCS sigchains, and signed coverage metadata that turns silent omission into a positive negative-observation. Reference verifier + conformance tests.

repo_info.description: Cross-platform attestation envelope spec for agent-native claims. Pointer-based evidence, custodian-signed coverage metadata, sigchain over a typed witnessed claim.

children.title: DOS Kernel
children.description: Deterministic trust kernel for agent fleets: verifies "done" claims from git evidence instead of self-report, arbitrates concurrent file access, audits commit claims against their own diffs.

repo_info.description: Catch your AI agents when they lie about what they shipped — verifies claims against git instead of believing the agent.

children.title: Adrian
children.description: Open-source, AARM-aligned runtime security for AI agents: analyzes tool calls and reasoning traces, then detects/blocks prompt injection, malicious tool use, and out-of-remit actions in-flight (audit or block mode). LangChain/LangGraph/OpenAI Agents SDK; self-hostable offline.

repo_info.description: Open-source runtime AI agent security tool - monitors and controls AI agents, catching malicious tool use, prompt injection, and policy drift in real time, before the agent acts.

children.title: Bounded Agents: Delegation Security for Multi-Agent AI Systems
children.description: Introduces the Agentic Principal Chain (APC): six deterministic authorization checks enforced outside the model that narrow delegated authority across multi-agent chains and block prohibited compositions of individually permitted actions (composition closure). Reference implementation and evaluation on GitHub. Article

repo_info.description: Bounded Agents: Delegation Security for Multi-Agent AI Systems - Reference Implementation and Evaluation Artifact

children.title: HOL Guard
children.description: Local-first security harness that intercepts tool calls in AI coding agents before files change or network is contacted. Scans skills, MCP servers, and plugins for supply-chain threats.

repo_info.description: Open-source antivirus for AI agents: block risky tools, secret access, prompt injection, malicious packages, MCP servers, plugins, and skills at runtime.

children.title: SourceryKit
children.description: Python SDK that verifies an agent's outbound requests against a source of truth using zero-knowledge proofs, so a call only goes out if the agent's claims check out. Hooks into the HTTP libraries to log each call and block anything not on the trusted-endpoint allow-list, MCP handoffs included.

repo_info.description: Python SDK for accurate and verifiable agent tool use. Agents verify that answers came from the right source and were not changed. Downstream agents detect 100% of errors and retry to achieve a 50% jump in answer accuracy.

children.title: LEASH-8
children.description: Control model for agents holding delegated authority, across eight domains: identity, secrets, tool/skill supply chain, approvals, containment, egress, observability, incident response. Ships a 24-statement scored self-assessment, the plan-vs-authorize gate pattern (model plans, policy decides, executor acts), an approval-design checklist for irreversible actions, and a reference A2A Agent Card. Docs and templates — no runtime component.

repo_info.description: LEASH-8: an 8-domain control model for AI agents with delegated authority. Scorecard, approval-design checklist, plan-vs-authorize pattern. Patterns from a live production agent operation, sanitized. Free, MIT.
